description:
Why isn't my product selling? What should I change in my listing?
(¿Por qué no vende mi producto? ¿Qué cambio en mi ficha?)

Match categories (`disponibles`). Diagnoses a product listing (Amazon, an own shop, another marketplace or a
draft): Wintraits Match Index (similarity to winners, 0-100, not a sales probability; always
call it by that name, `indice_match.texto`), the changes that
raise it most and the winning combinations within reach (missing one or two elements). On the free plan you
see the first changes; `bloqueado` says how many more the full report has and `acceso` which view was used.

Optional `atributos`: if you (the AI) read the listing yourself, call wintraits_opciones_concepto first and
follow its `instrucciones_extraccion`: use only what the listing says (never deduce), exactly the keys of
`atributos` and, for lista/categoria, only their `valores`; omit anything the listing does not say (we read it
from the text). Invalid keys or values return an error with the valid options.

Args:
    titulo: listing title.
    precio_eur: selling price in euros.
    num_imagenes: number of images in the listing.
    vinetas: bullet points of the listing.
    descripcion: listing description.
    volumen_ml: volume in ml, if not in the text.
    atributos: optional {key: value} read from the listing (keys and values from wintraits_opciones_concepto).
    categoria: subcategory (see wintraits_categorias_disponibles; e.g. "serums").
    pais: country code (see wintraits_categorias_disponibles; e.g. "ES").
    lang: "es" (default) or "en" (attribute names in English).

Free and unlimited during the beta (until 2027-03-31). Gratis y sin límite durante la beta (hasta el 31-mar-2027).
name: wintraits_diagnosticar_producto
